name: Northern Bear Paw RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at the OSM node 44.2748,-83.7207: gravel loops in pines; a small pond sits at the end of the north site row and a creek runs ~150 m SW through unbroken woods; no site sold as waterfront, small pond defaults down

name: Northern Nights Family Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 44.4798,-84.6612: loops in pine woods east of the county road; no water in frame (Higgins Lake is miles away)

name: Sharp Park Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 220 m frame) at 42.6262,-85.4577: a continuous row of ~20 RV pads runs along the lake's W shore 10-15 m from the water with docks at the waterline; operator sells these nightly as 'Full Hook Up (Lakeside)' (campsharppark.com rates, 2026)

name: The Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) around 44.4019,-85.3720: RV loop at the S edge of an open field off M-42; only water is a small round decorative pond mid-field with no pads on it

name: Bay Ridge RV Park & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 45.7872,-86.5657: open gravel loops on a slope W of the office, their W tips ~50-70 m back from the Garden Bay shore across rough ground and a boat-slip building; no pad at the water's edge. Operator sells 'Great View' sites (Open Campground, 2026) - a view, not frontage
